title: Add horizontal alignment audit profiles
summary: Add first-class horizontal alignment audits for KB↔KB, code↔code, and KB↔code consistency, with validation-gateway evidence support.

goal.outcome: Validation can require deterministic horizontal alignment evidence across same-layer docs, same-layer code, and KB-code claims.
acceptance: Audit exposes horizontal KB↔KB checks for deterministic conflicting/stale/duplicate canonical claims.
Audit exposes code↔code checks for API/ownership/import-contract drift using source graph evidence.
Audit exposes KB↔code checks comparing documented paths/claims to source graph and task/build evidence.
Validation preflight/report can require and cite horizontal audit profiles.
non_goals: Do not attempt unconstrained LLM semantic contradiction detection.
Do not block on low-confidence prose similarity alone.
Do not replace existing alignment/generated-parity audits.

delta.desired: Horizontal alignment is an explicit audit/gateway capability with deterministic evidence.
delta.current: Horizontal alignment relies on graph health, tests, file-structure audits, and validator judgment.
delta.closure: Close when horizontal audit profiles and validation evidence paths are implemented and tested.
